objective: Review the static registry addition for the two tracked filelist-derived templates and select the next publication step.

review_decision.reason: The existing sidecar registry now exposes exactly the two reviewed filelist-derived templates. Preview and operator-plan commands exit zero and keep the same coverage-output equivalence handoff fields without adding a new planner or runtime path.
review_decision.weakest_point: This is still static tracked-template support. It must not be read as arbitrary filelist parsing, native Verilator parser support, automatic dependency inference, or automatic optimal GPU allocation.
